case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for being so open about your wage costs. We value the craftsmanship and the long-standing cooperation with your foundry.

We cannot meet your proposed price, but we have put together three options for you. Each one rests on a longer contract term, which gives you planning security.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.80; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.49; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

Please let us know which option works best for you. We are happy to talk it through.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We value our long-standing cooperation and welcome your suggestion of a 24-month contract to ensure planning security for both our houses. We are willing to accept this longer term with our standard 30-day payment, provided the price remains sustainable for our foundry. 

We can therefore offer you a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This represents a significant step towards your position. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Moser,

Thank you for your revised offer and for your willingness to move to the longer contract term. We appreciate the step you have taken.

We cannot reach your price yet, but we have adjusted our options once more. Option C keeps your standard payment terms, while Options A and B offer a longer payment term in exchange for a different price.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 47.36; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.98; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 47.05; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

We hope one of these works for your foundry, and we are happy to talk it through by phone.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your revised offer and the constructive dialogue between our houses. For many years, our family foundry has valued the strong partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we remain deeply committed to working together. 

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In response to your movement on Option C, we are taking another step toward you with a price of €50.50 per unit. Along with this unit price, our Angebot includes a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We gladly accept your suggestion for a phone call to discuss this further and finalize our agreement. It is always a pleasure to find good solutions together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
